experiment: Experiment 64 — CORR adaptive fusion gate initialization sensitivity

base.initialization_source: same SHA-verified E61 per-fold epoch-10 shared state used by E62-E2; gate logits set before epoch 11

optimization.best_checkpoint: strict ACC improvement with historical val=test protocol

gate_parameterization: store logit(torch.tensor(configured_sigmoid_value)); edge and fusion gate vectors remain trainable
protocol_limits: Only the CORR adaptive fusion gate initial value differs from E62-E2; edge gates remain 0.5 and non-CORR fusion gates remain 0.001.
No OOF, reliability multiplier, extra model component, loss, or hyperparameter search.
Each group/fold branches from the exact SHA-verified E61 epoch-10 shared checkpoint used by E62-E2; gate logits are set to configured sigmoid-space values before epoch 11.
E62-E2 and E63-G1 best checkpoints are read-only references, not fine-tuning starts.
Historical val=test checkpoint selection, pre-CV preprocessing, and the transductive 871-node graph are retained.
Single seed and overlapping outer folds provide exploratory paired evidence only.
